# Module `pill_master_renderer_data::components::mesh_renderer`

Visibility: `{'restricted': {'parent': 1411, 'path': '::components'}}` · Source: `extensions\pill_master_renderer\modules\runtime\data\src\components\mesh_renderer.rs:1`

The mesh renderer component, and the builder that assembles one.

## Responsibilities

- Define [`MeshRendererComponent`](struct.MeshRendererComponent.md#rustdoc-item-1413), the pair of handles that makes an
  entity drawable, and [`MeshRendererComponentBuilder`](struct.MeshRendererComponentBuilder.md#rustdoc-item-1415), which fills in
  those two handles.

## Design

Shared and persistable: the managed mirror binds the same two handles, and
the reload migration keeps their values. The shared name is pinned rather
than derived from the module path; see [`crate::components`](../index.md#rustdoc-item-1411).
